system.name: Oobleck
system.one_liner: a system for resilient distributed training of large models using heterogeneous pipeline templates

components.name: Node Specification
components.role: shows how many nodes each of the three pipeline templates (A, B, C) is assigned, given N=13 nodes, model memory requirements, and fault tolerance threshold f

components.name: GPU-Stage Mapping
components.role: shows how each template's GPUs are mapped to pipeline stages (S1, S2, ...) of the Model

components.name: Model
components.role: the model whose layers are partitioned into stages for each template

components.name: Templates
components.role: the three heterogeneous pipeline templates (A, B, C) considered for instantiation

components.name: 13 Nodes
components.role: the total available nodes to be covered by pipeline instances

components.name: Global Batch
components.role: the total batch size (26) to be split across instantiated pipelines

components.name: Fault Tolerance Threshold
components.role: the threshold f=3 that the instantiation plan must satisfy

components.name: Plan 1
components.role: one feasible pipeline instantiation plan combining templates A, B, C with specific instance counts and minibatch sizes

components.name: Best Plan
components.role: the selected plan output after evaluating candidate plans

flows.what: template node counts mapped to GPU-stage layouts
instance counts (x1, x2) and minibatch sizes per template

content.key_idea: Oobleck first generates a small set of heterogeneous pipeline templates by mapping GPUs to model stages at different node counts, then enumerates feasible combinations of template instances that cover all available nodes and satisfy the fault-tolerance and batch-size constraints to pick a best plan.
content.reading_order: Left panel (a) read left to right: node specification (templates A/B/C sized 2/3/4 nodes) into GPU-stage mapping showing each template's stage layout. Right panel (b) read left to right: given inputs (templates, 13 nodes, global batch 26, fault tolerance 3), Plan 1 assigns instance counts and minibatches per template, arriving at the Best Plan.

summary: This two-panel figure shows Oobleck's planning algorithm overview. Panel (a), 'Generating pipeline templates', shows a Node Specification for three heterogeneous pipeline templates A, B, C sized 2, 3, and 4 nodes respectively (given N=13 total nodes, model memory requirements, and fault tolerance threshold f), and a GPU-Stage Mapping showing how each template partitions the Model into stages S1-S4 with dashed lines marking stage boundaries. Panel (b), 'Pipeline instantiation', shows how, given the three templates, 13 nodes, a global batch of 26, and fault tolerance threshold 3, a candidate Plan 1 assigns instance counts (A x1, B x1, C x2) and minibatch sizes per template, summing to 4 pipelines covering all 13 nodes and a total batch of 26, arriving at a Best Plan. Consistent light/medium/dark grayscale shading identifies each template across both panels.
summary_zh: 该图分两部分展示Oobleck规划算法：(a)节点规格生成三种异构流水线模板A/B/C(分别用2、3、4节点)及其GPU-阶段映射；(b)在13节点、全局批量26、容错阈值3约束下，方案1为各模板分配实例数与小批量大小，最终得到最佳方案。
